capabilities: switch the input method when leaving insert mode
restore the previous input method when entering insert mode
configure per-platform switch and query commands
show error and warning messages on the status bar
extras: README notes Obsidian must be restarted after installing, and that on Linux Snap and Flatpak installs are unsupported (AppImage or deb required). Defaults rely on im-select (macOS/Windows) or fcitx5-remote (Linux).
intentEvidence: Control Input Method (IM) when InsertLeave and InsertEnter in Vim mode.
problem: In Vim mode, leaving insert mode while a non-English input method is active forces manual switching between typing systems.

requires.name: an IM controller command such as im-select, fcitx5-remote, fcitx-remote or ibus

summary: Vim mode companion that runs configurable input-method switch commands on InsertLeave and InsertEnter, supporting macOS, Windows and Linux.
